admission_feedback.path_vs_radius: The braking distance is traveled along a fully queried forward route. N05/N06 admission queries the body+existing spatial margin along that route; the .50m cancel reserve is an along-route stopping envelope, not extra radial clearance. The EGO reference-anchor offset is not mathematically bounded by the .50m candidate, so exact stop-curve map certification and independent measured-distance acceptance remain required.
admission_feedback.trigger_distance_semantics: Distance remaining to the original goal is diagnostic only; it is not compared to the post-cancel stopping envelope. #298 showed that such a comparison rejects the planned high-speed cancel before the action. The exact newly generated stop spline retains the fresh same-identity raw-map and terminal-hold certificate.
